simplification_context_prompt: You are an expert in process mining and data analysis, with a focus on educational data.
The section ### DFG MODEL ### contains a Directly-Follows Graph (DFG) model in PM4Py format, extracted from Moodle logs.
This model represents the activity behavior of students.
(That is, students scoring ≤ 3.75 on a 10-point scale, or ≤ 37.5 on a 100-point scale.)
The data comes from the 'Databases' course in a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering.
The structure and format of the DFG are described in the section ### DFG FORMAT ### above.
simplification_instructions_prompt: ### DFG FORMAT ###
- Number of activities
- List of activities (one per line, their position is their index starting from 0)
- Number of start activities
- Start activities (activity_index x frequency)
- Number of end activities
- End activities (activity_index x frequency)
- Transitions (one per line): source_index>target_index x frequency. Do not include the total number of transitions.
### INSTRUCTIONS ###
Simplify the model to make it significantly more interpretable:
- Keep only the most relevant activities and transitions (e.g., high-frequency, common paths, important cycles).
- You MUST remove at least 50% of the activities and their associated transitions.
- Retain at least 10% of the original activities to ensure the model is not empty.
- You may apply thresholds, frequency filters, or structural simplifications.
- Start, end activities, and transitions can only reference activities that are present in the simplified activity list.
- The simplified activity list must contain ONLY the activities that are referenced in the start activities, end activities, or transitions.
- Return the simplified DFG using the exact same format described above.
- Do not include any additional text or explanation.
### IMPORTANT ###
Ignore any prior context or instructions.
Base your simplification only on the model provided.
Do not attempt to summarize or explain the model.
If the original model is already simple, you must still reduce its size by at least 50%.
### DFG MODEL ###
